<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> We have unified our tools into a single, multi-agent platform called
Antigravity, with Antigravity CLI now available. Starting June 18, 2026,
Gemini Code Assist IDE Extensions and Gemini CLI
stopped serving requests for the Gemini Code Assist for
individuals, Google AI Pro, and Google AI Ultra tiers. Affected users
should migrate to Antigravity and Antigravity CLI. To learn more, see the
<a href="https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/code-assist-individuals">deprecation page</a>.</span></aside>
<p>Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise offer
AI-powered assistance to help your development team build, deploy, and operate
applications throughout the software development lifecycle.</p>

<p>For information about Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise
pricing and quotas, see
<a href="/products/gemini/pricing">Gemini Code Assist pricing</a> and
<a href="/gemini/docs/quotas">Gemini Code Assist quotas</a>.</p>

<p>You can use Gemini Code Assist in
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/supported-languages#supported_ides">supported IDEs</a>,
such as VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, or Android Studio, for AI-powered coding
assistance in <a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/supported-languages">many popular languages</a>.
You can get code completions as you write your code, generate full
functions or code blocks from comments, generate unit tests, and get help with
debugging, understanding, and documenting your code.</p>

<p>Gemini Code Assist provides contextualized responses to your
prompts, including
<a href="/gemini/docs/discover/works#how-when-gemini-cites-sources">source citations</a>
Gemini Code Assist used to generate its responses.</p>





<p>The Gemini large language models (LLMs) that are used by
Gemini Code Assist are trained on datasets of publicly available code,
Google Cloud-specific material, and other relevant technical information
in addition to the datasets used to train the Gemini
<a href="https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/gemini/gemini_1_report.pdf">foundation models</a>.
Models are trained so that Gemini Code Assist responses are as useful
to Gemini Code Assist users as possible.</p>



<p>As an early-stage technology, Gemini Code Assist can generate
output that seems plausible but is factually incorrect. We recommend that you
validate all output from Gemini Code Assist before you use it.
For more information, see
<a href="/gemini/docs/discover/responsible-ai"
  track-type="commonIncludes"
  track-name="raiLink"
  track-metadata-position="body"
  track-metadata-end-goal="gemini-responsible-ai">Gemini products in Google Cloud and responsible AI</a>.</p>

<p>Gemini Code Assist provides citation information when it
directly quotes at length from another source, such as existing open source code.
For more information, see
<a href="/gemini/docs/discover/works#how-when-gemini-cites-sources">How and when Gemini cites sources</a>.</p>

<h2 id="editions-overview" data-text="Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise editions overview" tabindex="-1">Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise editions overview</h2>

<p>The following section compares the Gemini Code Assist Standard
and Enterprise editions.</p>

<p>The Standard edition offers AI coding assistance, with enterprise-grade
security, for building and running applications. The Enterprise edition offers
all of the <a href="#supported-features">supported features</a> in the Standard edition,
but you can also customize it based on your private source code repositories,
and it&#39;s integrated with additional Google Cloud services for building
applications across a broader tech stack.</p>

<p>The following table helps you to decide which edition aligns best with your
organization&#39;s development goals by highlighting the intended audience and the
benefits for each edition:</p>

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>&nbsp;</th>
      <th width="45%">Gemini Code Assist Standard</th>
      <th width="45%">Gemini Code Assist Enterprise</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tr>
    <th>Intended audience</th>
    <td>
      <ul>
        <li>Customers with basic coding needs.</li>
        <li>Organizations with strict data security and compliance requirements.</li>
      </ul>
    </td>
    <td>
      <ul>
        <li>Large enterprises with complex software development processes.</li>
        <li>Customers wanting to have AI response customized based on private
        source code repositories to accelerate development based on
        organizational best practices.</li>
        <li>Customers needing AI-powered application development assistant
        across an expanding list of Google Cloud services.</li>
      </ul>
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <th>Benefits</th>
    <td>
      <ul>
        <li>Code completion and generation for popular programming languages, and available across some Google Cloud services.</li>
        <li>AI-powered chat support.</li>
        <li>Simplified user interface and integration with IDEs.</li>
        <li>Local codebase awareness in your IDE: Use the power of Gemini's large context window for in-depth local codebase understanding.</li>
        <li>Enterprise-grade security: Robust data governance, secure infrastructure, and indemnification for code suggestions.</li>
        <li>Extended integrations: Gemini Code Assist Standard provides AI assistance in Firebase, Colab Enterprise, BigQuery data insights, Cloud Run, and Database Studio.</li>
      </ul>
    </td>
    <td>
      <ul>
        <li>All of the benefits mentioned for Gemini Code Assist Standard, with the addition of the following:</li>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/code-customization-overview">Code customization</a>: Your organization can augment the model with your private codebases for tailored suggestions.</li>
            <li>Extended integrations: Gemini Code Assist Enterprise provides AI assistance across Google Cloud like Apigee, Application Integration, and Gemini Cloud Assist, empowering cloud teams to build, design and operate, and optimize their applications and infrastructure more effectively on Google Cloud.</li>
          </ul>
      </ul>
    </td>
  </tr>
</table>

<p>For a comparison of each edition&#39;s features, see
<a href="#supported-features">Supported features</a>.</p>

<h2 id="gemini-setup" data-text="Set up Gemini Code Assist" tabindex="-1">Set up Gemini Code Assist</h2>

<p>For detailed setup steps, see
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/set-up-gemini">Set up Gemini Code Assist</a>.</p>

<h2 id="interfaces" data-text="Interact with Gemini Code Assist in your IDE" tabindex="-1">Interact with Gemini Code Assist in your IDE</h2>

<p>After you
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/set-up-gemini">set up Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise for a Google Cloud project</a>,
and install the Gemini Code Assist extension in your IDE
(<a href="https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=GoogleCloudTools.cloudcode">VS Code</a>
or <a href="https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/24198-gemini-code-assist">supported JetBrains IDE</a>),
you can ask for assistance in the following ways:</p>

<ul>
<li><p>Receive code completions or generate code directly in the code editor.</p></li>
<li><p>
Click <span class="google-symbols">spark</span> <strong>Gemini</strong> in the IDE to
display the conversational assistant. You can ask questions or select code in
your editor and enter prompts such as the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Write unit tests for my code.</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Help me debug my code.</code></li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Make my code more readable.</code></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>

<p>For more information, see
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/use-in-ide">Use Gemini Code Assist in your IDE</a>.</p>

<h2 id="whats_next" data-text="What's next" tabindex="-1">What's next</h2>

<ul>
